claim_verdicts.evidence: OpenTofu v1.10 tofu plan page: "The tofu plan command creates an execution plan, which lets you preview the changes that OpenTofu plans to make to your infrastructure." and "The plan command alone does not actually carry out the proposed changes". Current docs also: "Reads the current state of any already-existing remote objects"; "Proposes a set of change actions that should, if applied, make the remote objects match the configuration."

Round 2: the claim now covers only header words and + / ~, all in real OpenTofu 1.10.10 captures at stage-3: tofu-first-cluster.txt l.27-32 legend "+ create" and "# kind_cluster.this will be created"; tofu-drift.txt l.5-6 "will be updated in-place" / "~ resource"; tofu-plan-apply.txt l.7 "must be replaced"; tofu-state.txt l.8-9 "# kind_cluster.this will be destroyed" / "# (because kind_cluster.this is not in configuration)" (supports 'an object the files no longer declare').

Lifecycle v1.10: "By default, when OpenTofu must change a resource argument that cannot be updated in-place due to remote API limitations, OpenTofu will instead destroy the existing object and then create a new replacement object". Resource behavior: "Destroy and re-create resources whose arguments changed but cannot be updated in-place". Execution: tofu-plan-apply.txt l.7 "# kind_cluster.this must be replaced", l.8 "... # forces replacement".

Execution (OpenTofu 1.10.10): tofu-plan-apply.txt l.9 "Plan: 1 to add, 0 to change, 1 to destroy." for the single replaced kind_cluster.this, printed after the object lines; same form in tofu-first-cluster.txt l.56, tofu-drift.txt l.22, tofu-moved.txt l.5. Round 2: lesson now says 'A summary line after the objects', matching the claim.

Execution with tehcyx/kind v0.11.0 (tofu-first-cluster.txt l.7 "Installed tehcyx/kind v0.11.0"): tofu-plan-apply.txt l.7-9 "# kind_cluster.this must be replaced", "~ node_image = \"kindest/node:v1.34.11@...\" -> \"kindest/node:v1.33.7@...\" # forces replacement", "Plan: 1 to add, 0 to change, 1 to destroy."

Lifecycle v1.10: default replacement will "destroy the existing object and then create a new replacement object". kind Quick Start: "kind runs a local Kubernetes cluster by using Docker containers as 'nodes'." Execution: tofu-teardown.txt, after "Destroy complete! Resources: 1 destroyed." kind get clusters lists only "donhang" - destroying a kind_cluster deletes the kind cluster. Provider registry page could not be rendered.

Round 2: lesson now uses the suggested wording. Apply v1.10: "When you run tofu apply without passing a saved plan file, OpenTofu automatically creates a new execution plan as if you had run tofu plan, prompts you to approve that plan, and takes the indicated actions." Execution: tofu-first-cluster.txt l.56-62 "Plan: 1 to add...", "Do you want to perform these actions?", "Only 'yes' will be accepted to approve.", "Enter a value:" in that order.

Plan v1.10: "You can use the optional -out=FILE option to save the generated plan to a file on disk, which you can later execute by passing the file to tofu apply". Apply v1.10: "When you pass a saved plan file to tofu apply, OpenTofu takes the actions in the saved plan without prompting you for confirmation." Execution: tofu-plan-apply.txt l.18-20 prints only "Apply complete! Resources: 0 added, 0 changed, 0 destroyed." (no plan, no prompt).

Execution: tofu-plan-apply.txt l.22-29: "No changes. Your infrastructure matches the configuration." ... "Apply complete! Resources: 0 added, 0 changed, 0 destroyed." with no "Do you want to perform these actions?" line, whereas tofu-first-cluster.txt l.58 shows that prompt when there is an action. Plan v1.10: "If OpenTofu detects that no changes are needed ... tofu plan will report that no actions need to be taken."

tofu-plan-apply.sh l.17-20: comment "The plan lists every attribute, the cluster's credentials too" and `grep -e '^  # ' -e 'forces replacement' -e '^Plan:'`; a line starting with -/+ matches none of the three patterns. tofu-first-cluster.txt l.34-35 shows client_certificate, client_key among the attributes.

tofu-plan-apply.sh l.12-15 cp/trap/perl/diff, l.21-22 mv + trap - EXIT; header l.3 "(after scripts/devops/tofu-first-cluster.sh)"; main.tf l.21 holds node_image; output l.1 "21c21". Checked against the submodule working tree (git show at the tag was not permitted in this session); both lesson blocks match lines 8-22 and 25-35 character for character.

.github/workflows/ci.yml job iac (l.404-434): setup-opentofu, `tofu fmt -check -recursive deploy/tofu`, `tofu -chdir="$dir" init -backend=false -input=false`, `tofu -chdir="$dir" validate`; no `tofu plan` or `tofu apply` anywhere in the file (Grep 'tofu').

docker container ls reference: "The name filter matches on all or part of a container's name."; aliases include docker ps; example STATUS "Up 2 minutes". kind Quick Start: "kind runs a local Kubernetes cluster by using Docker containers as 'nodes'." and "To see all the clusters you have created, you can use the `get clusters` command." (sample output one name per line).

Conditional recommendation. Apply v1.10: automatic mode "creates a new execution plan ... prompts you to approve that plan"; saved plan mode "takes the actions in the saved plan without prompting". Core workflow: a final plan is reviewed before applying. Round 2: lesson now includes 'read it' for the saved plan, consistent with quiz q4 c.

Kubernetes tutorial: "A rolling update allows a Deployment update to take place with zero downtime. It does this by incrementally replacing the current Pods with new ones." Whole-cluster replacement: claims 3, 5, 6.

git show stage-3:scripts/k8s/cluster-up.sh l.10-16: "if kind get clusters 2>/dev/null | grep -qx donhang; then echo \"The cluster donhang already exists.\" ... else ... kind create cluster --name donhang --config deploy/k8s/kind-config.yaml". The config file is read only on the create branch, so an image edit there does nothing to an existing cluster.
